column1: # Every way work still reaches m2v (the Metal-to-Vulkan fallback being deleted) and what each becomes without it.
# m2v_routes_test.py keeps the product rows equal to what test/m2v_routes_scan.py reads from the plugin's sources.
# kind: product (the plugin and its compiler daemon), test (tests and harnesses that need m2v), tool (pack and seed tools).
#   A test row's route is bazel (a Bazel test, or tests named together), harness (a program or script outside Bazel)
#   or hwtest (a HW Test id); its raised_in names the dying files or targets it needs.
# route: pred (an RMPred refusal predicate), need (an RMNeed of RM_M2V), tag (a refusal line the plugin's own code raises),
#   sel (a selector raw/test/inventory.tsv leaves to m2v), bridge (a symbol of the m2v frontend or bridge), include (a
#   header of the m2v tree), class (an NB class looked up by name), ident (a field or function that holds or hands over
#   m2v objects), twin (an identifier naming a twin: m2v's, which the cut deletes, or raw's own barrier, stride, split,
#   reach and turned forms, which S4 renames), nvk (an NVK or NAK export or image name), dlsym (a name looked up at run
#   time), kernel (a kernel submission entry only NVK calls).
# raised_in: the files that raise it. gone: what it becomes once m2v is deleted: native (raw's own form exists, the route
#   is plumbing), form (Metal allows it and raw has no form yet: build one), error (Metal's failure, logged by the line
#   `logs` names: an error line kept in release), dead (unreachable without m2v: delete it), none (not an m2v route).
# owner: the studio branch or queued builder, cut (the builder that deletes m2v), - (none yet). status: open (work left
#   before the cut), cut (the cut deletes it, nothing to build), main (main already does what gone says),
#   <branch>@<hash> (built on that studio branch, not merged).
# boot21 (T-v5b's log): cbs= m2v command buffers (predicates), procs= processes that logged the line (once per process
